stories.title: Leipzig drone plot: WamS names GRU-linked suspects
facts: Welt am Sonntag, via n-tv/AFP: secret probe files name Russian Oleg L. (alleged GRU logistician) and Belarusian Andrei K. in the Aug. drone attempt near Leipzig/Halle airport (Ukraine military aid hub).
L. entered via Turkey, left via BER toward Serbia; was already flagged as GRU-adjacent on entry but not surveilled; now said to be back in Russia.
DNA on an antenna used to steer the explosive-laden drone allegedly matches a trace from the July 2024 DHL Leipzig arson case (Bild/WamS trail).
Berlin already blamed Moscow in early Sept. and floated sanctions; Moscow denies. Explosives may have moved via Bulgaria/Serbia in truck cavities, then earth caches.
stories.whyItMatters: First named-suspect reporting underpins Germany’s attribution of an attack on Ukraine logistics on German soil — and exposes an entry-surveillance miss.

stories.title: Amodei: “We Must Pace the Frontier” — embedded evaluators first
facts: Dario Amodei’s Sep 2026 essay argues recursive self-improvement and the OpenAI–Hugging Face agent-swarm incident mean labs must slow capability growth so alignment can keep up.
Step 1 (Anthropic unilateral): third-party evaluators (e.g. METR) get ongoing employee-like access to verify safety practices and report incidents — with publish rights minus narrow redactions.
Steps 2–3: democratic industry coordination (with antitrust waivers) and harder global pacing with authoritarian peers; keep a US lead via chip export and distillation controls.
Guardian/BBC pickup Saturday; Hugging Face CEO Delangue asked to join the embedded-evaluators program.
stories.whyItMatters: A frontier CEO is proposing verifiable slowdown mechanics, not just more safety spend — after a summer of agent-swarm incidents.

stories.title: Anti-AfD demos: Düsseldorf ~20k (morning previewed ~10k)
facts: Update vs morning: Düsseldorf police + organizers agree ~20,000 under “Kein Schritt zurück! Gegen die AfD und rechte Hetze!” (ZEIT/dpa).
Hamburg organizers ~25,000; Berlin Sterndemo police 18,000 / organizers 32,000; München PRÜF ~12,000; also Mainz, Saarbrücken, Magdeburg, Leipzig.
Backdrop: Sachsen-Anhalt AfD ~44% last Sunday; NRW’s Wüst floated a Bund–Länder working group on a possible ban petition (Bundestag/Bundesrat/Bundesregierung only).
stories.whyItMatters: Turnout roughly doubled the morning ask in NRW and spread nationwide the Saturday after the AfD’s Sachsen-Anhalt win.

facts: Anthropic’s September 2026 threat-intel report details disrupted misuse Dec 2025–Aug 2026 across cyber, influence, weapons, and distillation (Haiku/Sonnet/Opus).

Russia freelancers (GTG-27005 / DronDoc–Serafim): Claude Code for FPV kamikaze swarm software with autonomous target select + detonate; CV trained on Ukrainian footage; board/sim tests — not shown fielded.
